import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive multi-panel visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sleep_disorder_data = df.copy()
sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'] = sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorders = sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].unique()
for i, disorder in enumerate(disorders):
    subset = sleep_disorder_data[sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                alpha=0.6, s=80, label=disorder, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Stress Level distribution by BMI Category
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Normal Weight', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
available_bmis = [bmi for bmi in bmi_order if bmi in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
if not available_bmis:
    available_bmis = df['BMI Category'].unique()
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Stress Level', ax=ax2, palette='Set2', order=available_bmis)
ax2.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Stress Level Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Plot 3: Physical Activity Level vs Heart Rate colored by Age groups
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df['Age Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[0, 30, 40, 50, 100], labels=['<30', '30-40', '40-50', '50+'])
age_groups = df['Age Group'].cat.categories
for i, age_group in enumerate(age_groups):
    subset = df[df['Age Group'] == age_group]
    ax3.scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Heart Rate'], 
                alpha=0.6, s=70, label=age_group, color=colors[i])
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (minutes/day)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Heart Rate by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.legend(title='Age Group', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 4: Average Sleep Duration by Occupation (top 10)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
bars = ax4.barh(range(len(occupation_sleep)), occupation_sleep.values, color=colors[2])
ax4.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_sleep)))
ax4.set_yticklabels(occupation_sleep.index, fontsize=9)
ax4.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Top 10 Occupations by Average Sleep Duration', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# Add values on bars
for i, (bar, value) in enumerate(zip(bars, occupation_sleep.values)):
    ax4.text(value + 0.05, i, f'{value:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
